summary: Backend 14/14 pytest passed covering brands meta (20 brands, 3 seasons), tires CRUD, rim parsing, duplicate merge, validation (size/brand/season/qty), PATCH quantity (+/-/404/negative), movements sorted desc, and DELETE. Frontend dashboard loads with stats and movement card, navigation to Magazzino works, search/chips/qty +/- /delete all work on an existing row. However, the 'Nuove gomme' modal has a web rendering bug: modal slide-up only peeks title at bottom; form fields render below viewport making brand-select unreachable on 390x844 viewport.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal (justifyContent: flex-end + maxHeight 92%) with KeyboardAwareScrollView does not expand on Expo web. Only the header 'Nuove gomme' is visible at bottom edge; input-size, brand-select, season-select, input-quantity and submit are rendered below viewport (Playwright reports 'Element is outside of the viewport' for brand-select). Users cannot complete new tire creation on web preview.

issues: Modal card needs explicit flex height or min-height to expand on web; KeyboardAwareScrollView collapses without flex:1 wrapping

action_items: Fix AddTireModal web rendering: wrap KeyboardAwareScrollView in a View with flex:1 OR give modalCard an explicit height (e.g. height: '92%' instead of maxHeight), so the scroll area has size on web and all form controls become visible/interactive.
After fix, re-test modal: brand dropdown shows 20 options, season dropdown shows 3, submit creates tire, duplicate submit merges quantity (same row, +qty).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: duplicate-merge path uses existing size/brand (case-sensitive exact match) — acceptable per spec.
api.ts: BASE may be undefined if env missing; consider guard.
AddTireModal: web styling missing flex:1 on scroll parent causes collapsed content.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (dashboard, nav, list, qty +/-, delete, search, chips OK; add modal unusable on web)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created TEST_-prefixed tires and cleaned them up. Observed one pre-existing non-test tire ('185/60 R15 91V Michelin All Season').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. For UI, focus on AddTireModal rendering on Expo web (mobile viewport 390x844). After main agent fix, verify: modal opens with all fields visible, dropdowns functional, submit works, duplicate merges, movements update on dashboard cronologia.
rca_of_issue: AddTireModal uses <Modal transparent animationType='slide'> with backdrop justifyContent:'flex-end' and modalCard maxHeight:'92%'. On React Native Web, modalCard has no intrinsic height; KeyboardAwareScrollView inside also has no flex. The card collapses to the height of its padding+header only, so form controls below the header get rendered outside the viewport. Fix: either set height:'92%' on modalCard, add flex:1 wrapper for the scroll area, or use minHeight. Reproduced via Playwright at 390x844: clicking brand-select throws 'Element is outside of the viewport'.
